svg.title: Applying circumference to a circular path and a semicircular boundary
svg.desc: A first-party full circle of diameter 20 meters and a semicircle of diameter 12 units joined to a straight segment. Labels distinguish a full circumference from a half-circle arc plus straight edges.
svg.text: Choose exact π when possible; use 3.14 or another stated approximation when the context asks for a decimal estimate.
